name: deploy-mina-catalogue
description: A push to main or claude/** of mina-catalogue goes live on catalogue.houseofmina.store (scripts/cloud/deploy.sh)

steps.name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:slim
args: mkdir -p /workspace/photos; gcloud storage rsync -r gs://gemstrack-pos-site-builds/mina/ /workspace/photos/ --quiet || echo 'no photo cache yet'

steps.name: mirror.gcr.io/library/node:22
args: set -euo pipefail; git clone --quiet https://github.com/Ammar282828/mina-catalogue.git $$WORKDIR; cd $$WORKDIR; git fetch --quiet origin $$COMMIT; if git cat-file -e origin/main:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh 2>/dev/null; then git show origin/main:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh > /workspace/deploy.sh; else git show $$COMMIT:scripts/cloud/deploy.sh > /workspace/deploy.sh; fi; exec bash /workspace/deploy.sh
